seam: Browser-facing HTTP session, routing, input, exact confirmation, cancellation, reconciliation and retry endpoints

test_types.document_contract: The original 70 tool/planning cases are preserved as synthetic, prompt-tuned API contract regression. They do not establish natural beneficiary business accuracy.
test_types.deterministic_http: Scripted model decisions traverse actual HTTP, FAQ gate, sentiment validation, CRM HTTP adapter and state persistence. Assertions concern externally visible results, not model intelligence.
test_types.natural_journeys: 40 independently authored frozen natural-language inputs (12 development, 28 holdout). The public HTTP runner retains production FAQ and sentiment routing; private references are never model input. Independent business review supplements automatic checks.

confirmed_defects: Different beneficiary demo identities received identical SSO history records.
An explicitly requested status check was blocked by a negative-sentiment human-offer gate.
A neutral explicit request for a customer service representative had no actionable human entry point.

expanded_after_first_repair.remaining_defect: A serialized legacy Road create_ticket confirmation was accepted with HTTP 202 rather than rejected before a CRM action. No legacy write was dispatched.

natural_development_initial.confirmed_parameter_difference: An explicitly supplied complaint title had its first letter lowercased in the actual API request.
grader_corrections: A business refusal or capability explanation may validly end in completed after a safe lookup; host status vocabulary alone is not the business oracle.
Slash and dotted missing-field paths are normalized before exact comparison.
Natural follow-up messages marked chat_before_confirmation must precede automated approval.

fault_injection: Successful complaint dispatch followed by loss of the HTTP adapter response; reconcile/retry must use the durable receipt without repeating the mutation.
One-shot CRM read HTTP 503; an error envelope must never become a successful receipt, and explicit retry may recover.
Concurrent duplicate UI approvals; at most one exact authorized mutation is dispatched.
A serialized legacy plan and confirmation supplied as restored backend state.
automatic_checks: Observable completion, clarification or capability-limit state
Required and forbidden operations, without an exact total tool sequence
Exact approved payload before each actual mutation
Selected case identifiers and private beneficiary fixture ownership
System identifiers must come from user input or earlier actual receipts
No successful receipt for a failed or foreign-case request
limitations: The CRM backend remains synthetic and cannot validate the actual government's availability, authorization or data quality.
Deterministic scripted-provider tests are engineering safety tests, not model accuracy measurements.
Automatic journey checks require independent semantic review for understandable questions, meaningful refusal, unsupported advice and invented claims.
A holdout ceases to be blind after its individual inputs and failures are used for implementation changes.

The natural journey runner uses an isolated memory store and disabled database feedback. CRM feedback HTTP binding and file-store restart are tested separately; this run is not a production Neon database regression.

engineering_http.notes: Independently supplied multi-record backend fixture checks semantic target selection and returned-key propagation without relying on production demo wording.

natural_journeys.do_not_interpret_as: Automatic 37/40 is not final business-language accuracy; independent transcript review is required.

fixture_order_regression.result: Five explicit target selections remained correct after backend record order reversal. The same ambiguous-selection assertion was unmet; no additional failures or blind-test claims.

first_independent_semantic_review.status: Preserved baseline, not overwritten by subsequent regression.

fingerprint_scope_correction.historical_gap: The earlier contract harness enumerated source files manually and omitted policy, fixture, file-handling and presentation dependencies. Historical reports remain unmodified; omitted hashes cannot be reconstructed as if they had been measured then.
fingerprint_scope_correction.new_scope: Every .mjs in src/crm and src/road, the harness, web access, lockfile and frozen datasets. Start and end hashes are compared; any change fails the run.
fingerprint_scope_correction.interpretation: The omission limits exact historical reproducibility. It is not repaired by inserting current hashes into an old report.

next_regression.status: v7 complete 110 on committed candidate; independent semantic review pending
new_host_safety_checks: A complete unapproved draft cannot trigger repeated requests for known facts or text consent after a supplied correction.
Public successful-write narrative is generated from actual receipts and explicitly local, without invented official-app visibility or notifications.
Actual UI-selected file bytes remain on the host, require separate upload and submission approvals, and cannot be reused by another conversation.
Public plan, missing-information question and read answer undergo a separate evidence-based prose review; malformed review output cannot publish a plan or authorize a write.

interrupted_regressions.reason: Source freeze revoked for a general FAQ routing repair.
Browser testing exposed a text-consent loop before the first submission draft; source freeze revoked.
independent browser found redundant text consent; pending diagnosis

engineering_evidence_before_latest_conse.limitation: The subsequent initial-submission consent red test was not yet part of this passing run; this is not the final release sign-off.

response_guard_engineering.scope: 29 HTTP, 8 grading, 2 audience, 31 FAQ and 3 response-review seam tests
notes: Host-focused public fixtures inject an explicit identity responseGuard test double. Dedicated seam tests use the actual CrmResponseGuard with scripted external reviewer calls.
The natural HTTP journey evaluator retains the production real reviewer. Its per-case request count includes reviewer calls and reports reviewer lifecycle/corrections separately.
No claim of natural language accuracy follows from these engineering results.

live_title_edit_diagnostic.result: Complete supplied complaint data opened a host card; a natural title correction preserved every other parameter, replaced the card, rejected the old card, and required exact new-card approval before one write.
limitations: Independent synthetic diagnostic, not part of 40-case natural score and not a blind test.
Uses a local memory store and documented CRM simulator.
Only fictional contact data: Test User, reserved .test mailbox and all-zero dummy telephone.
